name_input: MEDTECH REMEDIES PRIVATE LIMITED; MEDTECH REMEDIES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export (outbound) shipment record found. ImportKey page for slug 'medtech-remedies-private-limited' shows only India INBOUND customs records: "Total Shipments 120 Records detected", "Trading Partners 3", "Latest Cargo 2026-01-07", with every visible row having India as Destination, e.g. "2026-01-07 | FOSHAN JOINCHAMP MEDICAL DEVICE CO.,LTD | MEDTECH REMEDIES PRIVATE LIMITED | PARTS OF BASE ASSEMBLY ZC-S400 B TYPE WITH HANGING TABLE M200 ... (INTEGRAL DENTAL UNIT) | Shenzhen, CHINA -> BANGALORE ICD INWFD6, India | HS 90184900 | BOL 6754590". No row with India as origin/destination abroad was seen. Source counter: ImportKey claims 120 shipments; 5 detail rows were actually rendered on the free page (2026-01-07, 2025-12-31, 2025-12-22, 2025-11-12, 2025-07-21) — all imports. Slug variants tried: 'medtech-remedies-private-limited' (120 records, imports only), 'medtech-remedies-pvt-ltd' (page exists, zero records rendered), 'medtech-remedies' (page exists, zero records rendered).
domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply evidence retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits: null — not found in accessible sources. Note: the company's own address on the ImportKey record is "60 8B MERCY BATIMENT 2ND FLOOR, KIZ HAVANA ROAD PANAMPILLY NAGAR" (Kochi, Kerala), and the import rows show goods cleared at BANGALORE ICD, DELHI AIR CARGO ACC, SAHAR AIR and CHENNAI SEA, which is consistent with an India-based importer/distributor, but this is an inference from import records, not proof of domestic sales.
note: Role: importer/distributor of dental and medical equipment (integral dental units, autoclaves, covered stents), not a manufacturer — declared HS 330690/940210 does not match the observed trade HS codes 90184900 (dental unit parts), 90219090 (stents) and 84192010 (autoclaves); per project rules this is not a rejection ground, actual HS should be corrected to 9018/9021/8419. Shipment factuality: (a) EXPORT — no outbound shipment found; the 120 records on ImportKey are all inbound into India, so there are no export records with date/destination/B-L to cite. (b) DOMESTIC — no GST turnover, GeM/CPPP contract or annual-report evidence found; 'следов поставок не найдено' on the domestic side as well. (c) What IS confirmed is import activity only: 5 dated import B-Ls (6754590, 6632546, 6466504, 4174565, 3385269) from Chinese and Puerto Rico suppliers. Caveat on data quality: the ImportKey free view mixes several distinct entities under one name — the supplier list shows MEDTECH REMEDIES PRIVATE LIMITED alongside DOME HEALTHCARE PRIVATE LIMITED, EQUITRON MEDICA PRIVATE LIMITED, MEDIEQUIP INDIA and S M SCIENTIFIC INSTRUMENTS PRIVATE LIMITED, and the port counts (SHENZHEN 50, SAHAR AIR 50) suggest aggregated/duplicated rows, so the '120 shipments' figure should not be treated as verified volume. Revenue and export volume: null (not public). Search tooling (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down during this check and volza/eximpedia/trademo/importgenius returned 403 or JS challenges, so absence of export and domestic evidence is a limitation of accessible sources, not a positive finding of no trade.
